body:
i wrote a simplistic description of how jsdoc2md works [here](https://github.com/jsdoc2md/jsdoc-to-markdown/wiki/How-jsdoc2md-works). The raw jsdoc data is passed into jsdoc-parse, which transforms it into something more useful for passing into handlebars.

jsdoc2md works downstream of jsdoc. If you only want to parse jsdoc comments (and not source code, as jsdoc does) then your best option is [doctrine](https://github.com/eslint/doctrine).
